timing: Written after the schema and PRISM source gates passed but before any historical predictability value, recovery summary or H1 coefficient was opened.
reason: Historical phenological correlation is expected to decay with spatial separation and may vary by latitude/climate regime. The frozen primary already controls route distance; additional geometry checks are added as sensitivities rather than changing the primary model.
mandatory_geometry_sensitivities: report Pearson correlation between predictability and route distance before H1 interpretation
if absolute correlation between predictability and distance exceeds 0.8, label H1 interpretation high-collinearity regardless of coefficient significance
claim_rule: A predictability association that disappears after geometry controls is interpreted as spatial-geometry dependence, not evidence that environmental information reliability itself explains catch-up.
